title: Control flags X18d: the 10 bypass flags become explicit CLI parameters that write an audit record, or they are removed
summary: 10 bypasses are read from the environment: EVOLVE_SANDBOX, EVOLVE_USE_PHASE_REGISTRY, EVOLVE_OPERATOR_CONFIRM, EVOLVE_SHIP_AUTO_CONFIRM, EVOLVE_PHASE_<X>_BIN, BRIDGE_ALLOW_BYPASS, BRIDGE_DRY_RUN, BRIDGE_ALLOW_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, BRIDGE_ALLOW_OPENAI_API_KEY and BRIDGE_HUMAN_SIMULATION. They leave no record and reach the LLM children. List with readers: docs/architecture/control-flags.md class (c). Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §27 step 4; ADR-0156 rule 13.
fix: For each bypass, either add an explicit CLI parameter that writes a ledger record and a CONTROL_BYPASS_USED signal (INFO), or remove it. EVOLVE_OPERATOR_CONFIRM keeps -operator as the only surface. EVOLVE_SANDBOX=off is refused inside a phase (spec §7). Register CONTROL_BYPASS_USED in the Signal Center.
acceptance: RED first: EVOLVE_SANDBOX=off turns the sandbox off with no ledger record and no signal today
Each class (c) name has no environment read after the change
Each bypass parameter writes one ledger record and one CONTROL_BYPASS_USED signal
Each removed bypass is listed in the CHANGELOG
Changed functions at 100% coverage; control-flags.md, signal-codes.md and runtime-reference.md updated
